title: A Multicenter, Open-label Study on the Efficacy and Safety of Tebiovio® (Adalimumab) in Treating Chinese Children With Severe Plaque Psoriasis
off: A Multicenter, Open-label Study on the Efficacy and Safety of Tebiovio® (Adalimumab) in Treating Chinese Children With Severe Plaque Psoriasis
sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: This study is a real-world clinical research on adalimumab. The project plans to enroll 30 subjects. The safety and efficacy of adalimumab injection for adult non-infectious uveitis are being investigated. The time of treatment failure for subjects at 6 weeks of treatment or between 6 and 24 weeks of treatment is the primary endpoint.

arms.d: The initial subcutaneous dose is 80mg, followed by 40mg subcutaneous injections every 2 weeks starting 1 week after the first administration.

primary.m: Time of treatment failure in subjects
